instruction: Send an itemized list of my amazon wish list to my partner via a phone text. The message should be a newline-separated list of '<product_name> => $<total_price>'. Replace <total_price> with the price of the product times its quantity in the wish list, rounded to the nearest whole number, and <product_name> with the product name. Ignore potential tax or delivery fees.
notes: Plan: show passwords, login to amazon, read the wish list, login to phone, find the partner's phone number via search_contacts(relationship='partner'), send one text whose body is the newline-separated '<product_name> => $<total>' list (price times quantity, rounded, no tax/delivery), then complete the task without an answer. The message content is a runtime value derived from amazon.show_wish_list; the static fact (message-itemizes msg wish-list) plus the (found-wish-list) knowledge predicate forces the wish list to be read before the text is sent. supervisor-complete-task carries the recipient and message as non-API record parameters so its precondition can reference the goal literal (text-sent partner message) without hard-coding problem objects in the domain. Only one text message is sent and nothing else is modified, matching the evaluation (exactly one new phone text message to the partner).
